description: Image Description: The image depicts a bathroom scene. Central to the image is a white toilet with a closed lid. On top of the toilet tank, there is a pink sponge. To the right of the toilet, there is a toilet paper holder mounted on a wooden cabinet, with a roll of toilet paper on it. On the floor next to the toilet, there are two additional rolls of toilet paper and a small black object, possibly a phone or a book. The floor has a light-colored tile
